The blog post and a law-firm deal note show the provider is dead only in part - the company was acquired on 2026-03-17 - but its docs still serve and the product still runs, so the record is fails-egress rather than dead. The reader did not rewrite the link: the origin returned a real 404 body with upstream_status 404.
